description_en: Obtain a temporary download URL for the pipeline scan report
description_zh: 获取流水线扫描报告临时下载地址
name: GetPipelineScanReportUrl

parameters.help_en: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: Path to the scan report, which can be retrieved through the API at https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460565.html
parameters.help_zh: 扫描报告路径，可通过API https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460565.html 获取
parameters.name: report_path

reportUrl.description_en: Temporary download URL for the scan report, with a validity period of one hour
reportUrl.description_zh: 扫描报告的临时下载地址，一个小时有效期

requestId.description_en: Request ID. Each request has a unique value, which facilitates troubleshooting later
requestId.description_zh: 请求id，每次请求都是唯一值，便于后续排查问题
requestId.title_en: 请求id，每次请求都是唯一值，便于后续排查问题

success.description_en: true if the API call succeeded, false if the API call failed
